name: BeiDou (北斗)
tagline: China's GNSS — global ops since 2020; unique MEO + IGSO + GEO hybrid
description: China's GNSS, formally BeiDou-3 in current form. Unique hybrid architecture mixing MEO (24 satellites at 21,500 km, 55°), inclined geosynchronous (IGSO, 3 satellites), and GEO (3 satellites). Full global coverage declared July 2020. The only GNSS with short-message satellite communication capability built into the signal — users can send short text messages directly through the constellation, useful in remote-area emergency comms.
best_known_for: China's GNSS — global ops since 2020; unique MEO + IGSO + GEO hybrid
